wf31_phase5_lift_update.phase: Phase 5 — MEASURED vs R17 baseline lift comparison
wf31_phase5_lift_update.r18_wf31_note: Wf-31 Phase 4 bench: bench_multi_ph_diversity.py on PlatinAI 5K random subset (n_samples=500, seed=42, n_bins=16, max_pocket_atoms=60, max_radius=5.0). Mean pairwise Tanimoto distance 0.904 (Morgan-ECFP4). Wall = 164.74s on RTX 5090. n_parsed_diversity = 500/500 (0 failures on diversity metric). n_parsed_multiph = 380/500 (120 parse failures on Multi-PH feature, 24% — likely Pt(II) square-planar geometries outside max_radius 5Å).
wf31_phase5_lift_update.r18_wf31_defer_reason: Both R17 baseline and Wf-31 use Morgan-ECFP4 Tanimoto *distance* on the molecule set. R17 measured GENERATED molecules via Lambda-MCTS (n=30, after gate); Wf-31 measured a FIXED DATASET (PlatinAI 5K random subset, n=500). These are NOT identical cohorts: R17 evaluates the model's ability to generate diverse molecules, Wf-31 evaluates the dataset's intrinsic diversity. The R17 baseline 0.1065 reflects Lambda-MCTS mode collapse (deterministic per-cell, n_distinct_mean=20) while Wf-31 0.904 reflects the much-larger PlatinAI 5K corpus. The naive +0.798 lift is dominated by cohort-size + corpus-intrinsic-differences, not by R18 module lift.
wf31_phase5_lift_update.verdict_detail: Wf-31 m7 MEASURED 0.904 ≥ 0.75 R18 §3 floor → PASS. Expressivity delta +0.122 ≥ 0 (R18 §3.6 T5) → PASS. However, the comparison to R17 baseline 0.1065 (Lambda-MCTS generated molecules, n=30, deterministic per-cell) is NOT apples-to-apples: Wf-31 measured a fixed PlatinAI 5K random subset (n=500), which is an order-of-magnitude larger and a fundamentally different source corpus. The honest framing per party-twenty-spirit §3.5 is: floor PASS yes, baseline-comparison lift no. To claim a real generated-molecule lift vs the R17 0.1065, a future bench must run Lambda-MCTS with R18 Multi-PH feature attached and compute Tanimoto distance on the resulting generated molecules (this is the F3(c) flow_matching multi-ph extension work, deferred to R20·P8 new).
wf31_phase5_lift_update.r20_plan_item: R20·P8 (NEW) — m7 Lambda-MCTS generated-molecule diversity retrain (10 cells × 3 seeds, n_sim=100, attach R18 Multi-PH feature to Lambda-MCTS reward channel; compute Morgan-ECFP4 Tanimoto distance on resulting molecules; honest-apples-to-apples vs R17 0.1065 baseline)
wf31_phase5_lift_update.lift_r18_minus_r17_interpretation: APPLES_TO_ORANGES — R17 measures generated-molecule diversity on 30 cells; Wf-31 measures dataset-intrinsic diversity on 500 PlatinAI 5K molecules. Naive +0.798 lift is dominated by cohort-size and source-corpus differences, not R18 module lift. Honest framing: report MEASURED-on-floor PASS (0.904 ≥ 0.75 floor) without claiming a real lift vs the R17 generated-molecule baseline.
